risks.risk: Engine model/compatibility unknown (wrong engine for the buyer’s car).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the engine code/plate (and the full engine bay fitment info: make/model/year of the donor car).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used engine with unknown compatibility.

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (could have internal faults not visible in photos).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the engine starting and idling (cold start if possible) plus a diagnostic scan/OBD report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case for remote buying).

risks.risk: Knock/noise claim cannot be verified remotely.
risks.proof: Ask for audio video while idling and revving lightly (showing no knocking sound).

risks.risk: Mileage and 'never opened' cannot be confirmed from the single wide shot.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of seals/gaskets and any tamper marks, plus photos of the cylinder head cover area and oil pan area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly opened/overhauled or with unknown wear.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (starter, alternator, sensors, mounts) or damage not visible.
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo of included parts and close-ups of key components (starter, alternator, alternator bracket, sensors, mounts).
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only with unknown completeness.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the engine code/label (and any VIN/engine plate) so we can confirm exact engine type.
Send a video of the engine starting and idling (with audio) showing no knock.
Send a diagnostic scan/OBD report (or any test sheet) if they truly tested it.
Send close-up photos of seals/gaskets and tamper marks to support 'never opened'.
Confirm what is included (starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, wiring harness) with a parts checklist photo.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but the exact engine identity and the seller’s key claims (tested/working, no knock, low mileage, never opened, Belgium tokunbo) are not verifiable from the single image.
